2026_03_CIN_PIT.headline: Burrow tests Pittsburgh’s defense while Rodgers searches for more answers
2026_03_CIN_PIT.paragraph1: Joe Burrow takes an unbeaten Cincinnati team into Pittsburgh against a Steelers offense that has struggled to generate yardage through two weeks. Aaron Rodgers is getting the ball out more slowly than he did last season, which gives the Bengals a chance to make Pittsburgh’s protection hold up longer. Cincinnati has injury questions along its defensive front, while the Steelers are monitoring several offensive contributors. The divisional matchup hinges on which quarterback can avoid letting pressure dictate the game.
2026_03_CIN_PIT.model_rationale: Cincinnati has the stronger offensive baseline behind Burrow, while Pittsburgh needs Rodgers to speed up the passing game and prevent the Bengals from dictating down and distance.
